We need to fix compilation errors. The test code uses Mockito annotations, but we can avoid needing Mockito by removing those imports and annotations, and using our own dummy ValidationContext subclass already defined. The fields annotated with @Mock are not needed; we can just instantiate them manually. So remove @Mock and imports.

Also ValidationContext constructor signature differs. Need to adapt DummyValidationContext to match actual constructor. Let's inspect ValidationContext class? Not provided, but error says required: URIFactory,URNFactory,JsonMetaSchema,JsonSchemaFactory,SchemaValidatorsConfig. So we need to call super with appropriate arguments. Could use nulls for all? But there are 5 parameters. Provide null for each. So super(null,null,null,null,null). However types: URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig. All can be null. So modify constructor call.

Also need to expose fields lastPath, lastNode, lastParent, and resetCaptured method. Since validationContext variable is declared as ValidationContext, we need to cast to DummyValidationContext to access those fields. Simpler: change type of validationContext field to DummyValidationContext. That way we can call methods and access fields directly. So modify field declaration.

Also need to import static assertions from JUnit: import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; Then assertSame etc will be available.

Also need to fix complex object building: .set returns JsonNode, but they used .set(String,ObjectNode). Actually JsonNodeFactory's objectNode().set(String, JsonNode) returns ObjectNode. They attempted to chain .set with ObjectNode param but they used ObjectNode not JsonNode. Should use .set("name", JsonNodeFactory.instance.objectNode().put("type","string")). That's fine. The error: method set(String,ObjectNode) not found because set expects JsonNode. So need to cast or change type. Use .set("name", (JsonNode) JsonNodeFactory.instance.objectNode().put("type","string")). But simpler: just build a simpler complex node without chaining many .set. Could create ObjectNode complex = JsonNodeFactory.instance.objectNode(); complex.put("type","object"); ObjectNode props = complex.putObject("properties"); props.set("name", JsonNodeFactory.instance.objectNode().put("type","string")); etc. Simpler.

Also need to adjust imports: remove Mockito imports, add static assertions import.

Also need to adjust usage of validationContext in tests: they use validationContext.lastPath etc. Since validationContext is DummyValidationContext, fields are accessible (package-private). So fine.

Also need to adjust teardown: validationContext.resetCaptured() works.

Now adjust code accordingly.

Let's produce corrected test class.
